_readme: Copy the site renders that is not a verbatim spec block.
Every entry names where it came from. check-unsanctioned-copy.mjs fails on anything
rendered that is neither in docs/spec.md nor listed here, and on any entry here that
status awaiting-client = on the site, no source. Listed in docs/PENDING-COPY.md 1f
for the client to approve or replace. Not a free pass.
